title.en: H3 video: 1088p and 1440p tiers are offered and priced by resolution
title.zh: H3 视频：1088p 与 1440p 档位开放，并按分辨率单独定价

summary.en: `minimax-h3-video` now offers `1088p` and `1440p` on the six standard-tier endpoints that accept them. Each carries its own per-second price (`0.030` and `0.035 USD/second`), selected from the request's `resolution` by the task billing expression. Upstream `1080p` stays unoffered.
summary.zh: `minimax-h3-video` 在支持它们的六个标准档端点上开放 `1088p` 与 `1440p`，各自带独立每秒单价（`0.030` 与 `0.035 USD/秒`），由任务计费表达式按请求的 `resolution` 选取。上游 `1080p` 仍不开放。

body.en:
## Change

`minimax-h3-video` now accepts two more billing tier labels: `1088p` and `1440p`. They are available on the six standard-tier endpoints whose upstream workflows accept them; the fast and higher-quality tiers keep their single endpoint each and do not offer these resolutions.

## Pricing

Per-second billing has no resolution dimension, so the two tiers cannot be expressed by the base unit price alone. They are priced by resolution in the task billing expression:

| Tier | Rate |
| --- | --- |
| `480p` / `736p` / `768p` | `0.025 USD/second` |
| `1088p` | `0.030 USD/second` |
| `1440p` | `0.035 USD/second` |

Group multipliers still apply on top, so a fast-tier `1088p` request would be rejected rather than silently repriced (that tier has no such endpoint).

## Impact

- Higher resolutions now cost more than the base tiers instead of being unrequestable.
- Upstream `1080p` (three workflows) stays unoffered and keeps returning `400` (`plugin_usage_invalid`).
- Requests for `1088p` / `1440p` on tiers without a matching endpoint return `400`; nothing is silently downgraded or billed as `768p`.

## Documentation

- [MiniMax H3 video line](/en/api-reference/video-series/models/minimax-h3-video)
body.zh:
## 变更

`minimax-h3-video` 新增两个计费档位标签：`1088p` 与 `1440p`。它们只在六个标准档端点上可用（这些端点的上游工作流接受这两档）；高速档与升级画质档各只有一个端点、不支持这两档。

## 定价

按秒计费没有分辨率维度，因此这两档无法只靠基准单价表达，改由任务计费表达式按分辨率定价：

| 档位 | 单价 |
| --- | --- |
| `480p` / `736p` / `768p` | `0.025 USD/秒` |
| `1088p` | `0.030 USD/秒` |
| `1440p` | `0.035 USD/秒` |

分组倍率仍在其上叠加；高速档请求 `1088p` 会因没有候选端点被拒绝，而不是被静默改价。

## 影响

- 更高分辨率现在比基准档更贵，而不是完全无法请求。
- 上游 `1080p`（三个工作流）仍不开放，传入继续返回 `400`（`plugin_usage_invalid`）。
- 在没有对应端点的档位上请求 `1088p` / `1440p` 会返回 `400`；不会静默降级，也不会按 `768p` 计价。

## 文档

- [MiniMax H3 视频专线](/zh/api-reference/video-series/models/minimax-h3-video)
